title: Dumpling Booth
tagline: Turn a laptop and a TV into a playful voice AI booth.
description: Meet a quick-witted dumpling shop host, play one of five conversation games, and receive a gift. Build the dual-screen interface, live captions, timed announcements, and persistent inventory with your own service accounts.
author: shczhen
